93719bbe: Valorant is developed by Riot Games, the studio behind League of Legends. Riot wanted a precise tactical shooter with distinctive hero abilities.
88f4a3a1: What is the main objective of a Valorant match (excluding Deathmatch)?
Attackers plant the Spike (a bomb) on a designated site (A, B or sometimes C) and defenders must stop or defuse it. The first team to 13 rounds wins.
bedb12c5: What is the most powerful and expensive weapon in the game?
The Operator is the most expensive sniper rifle (4,700 credits) and the most powerful, killing in one shot to the body or head. A decisive weapon that demands great precision.
105fa8ab: Which class of agents specializes in gathering information?
Initiators gather information and open up sites, like Sova with his Recon Bolt, Breach with his seismic blasts or Fade with her Prowlers.
8c1c0ad0: Which agent can become temporarily invisible?
With his ultimate, Dimensional Drift, Yoru slips into another dimension where he is invisible and invulnerable, to scout for information.
fac28146: How many agents were available when Valorant launched in 2020?
11 agents were available at Valorant's launch in June 2020. Riot has added new ones regularly since.
f151db6c: What is the highest rank in Valorant's ranked system?
Radiant is the highest rank, reserved for the very best players in each region, listed on a public leaderboard.
1958dd4f: Which Valorant agent is inspired by Japanese ninjas?
Yoru is a Japanese agent inspired by the shinobi arts of illusion: he can create decoys, teleport and turn invisible with his ultimate, Dimensional Drift.
831e0ee7: What do you need to do to shoot accurately in Valorant?
Counter-strafing, stopping your movement before shooting, is the essential technique in Valorant. Moving while firing causes heavy spread with every weapon.
3147c19c: Which agent can bring a dead teammate back to life once per round?
Sage can revive a fallen teammate with her ultimate, Resurrection, a unique ability that can turn a round around.
d7323b00: Which Valorant map is inspired by an Italian city with a central plaza?
Ascent is inspired by Venice, Italy, with a central plaza where both teams fight for mid control and doors that either side can open or close.
1a99b873: How long does it take to defuse the Spike by default?
Defusing the Spike takes 7 seconds, during which the defuser is vulnerable and can't move. The Spike detonates 45 seconds after being planted.
acd6261b: Which Controller agent can create a toxic zone with her wall and chemical smokes?
Viper is the poison Controller: her toxic smokes hurt enemies and reduce their health. Her Toxic Screen can block a whole lane and her ultimate, Viper's Pit, cuts off a site.
3cc3418b: Which of Sova's Initiator abilities lets him scan enemy angles?
The Recon Bolt is Sova's signature ability: an arrow that reveals nearby enemies with two pulses, essential for showing the team enemy positions without risk.
d578f9fa: Which Valorant Duelist comes from the Philippines and uses electricity?
Neon is a Filipino Duelist who wields electricity: sprints, electric walls and lightning bursts with her ultimate, Overdrive.
2eda7847: Which Valorant agent uses walls of water to block lines of sight?
Harbor is the Indian Controller who wields water: his Cascade and High Tide walls block vision, Cove shields an area, and his ultimate, Reckoning, sends geysers that concuss enemies.
61929d2d: What is a player's base health in Valorant?
Players start with 100 HP and no armor: armor is bought each round, Light Shields (25) or Heavy Shields (50), reducing damage from body shots.
61d493df: How much does heavy armor cost in Valorant?
The Heavy Shield costs 1,000 credits and gives 50 armor, recommended for strong buy rounds. The Light Shield (400 credits) gives 25 armor.
2cb78542: Which Duelist can teleport to a marker he sends across the ground?
Yoru's Gatecrash sends a tether across the ground that he can teleport to instantly, creating unexpected angles of attack. His ultimate, Dimensional Drift, makes him invisible to gather information.
ca566a2c: How many credits do you start with in the first round of Valorant?
The first round starts with 800 credits, enough for a pistol (the Classic is free) and some utility. Credits then come from winning rounds, kills and objectives.
8e2259d3: Which agent can heal herself after killing enemies?
Reyna feeds on the souls of her victims: after a kill, she can heal herself (Devour) or become briefly intangible (Dismiss).
7ccf909c: How many maps were playable when Valorant launched in June 2020?
At launch, four maps were available: Bind, Haven, Split and Ascent. Icebox arrived a few months later.
f143c5a7: What is the maximum number of credits a player can hold in Valorant?
The maximum is 9,000 credits: anything beyond that is lost. The cap stops players from hoarding unlimited savings.
b3810dd8: Which Controller can place smokes anywhere on the map from her position?
Astra is the cosmic Controller who places stars anywhere on the map from her astral form, then turns them into smokes (Nebula), stuns (Nova Pulse) or pulls (Gravity Well).
036b4873: How long does it take to plant the Spike in Valorant?
Planting the Spike takes 4 seconds, during which the player is vulnerable and stationary. Defusing takes 7 seconds. These timings are crucial for tactical decisions.
294ef335: Which agent can deploy a turret that fires at enemies automatically?
Killjoy can place a Turret that detects and fires at enemies in its cone of vision. Visible and destructible, it is mostly useful for watching flanks and gathering information.
fa576507: Which agent's ultimate calls down a precision orbital strike?
Orbital Strike is Brimstone's ultimate: he can target any area of the map from his tactical map for a deadly laser strike. Perfect for clearing enemies off the Spike.
cf6167cd: Which agent can create a long toxic wall across the map?
Viper's Toxic Screen is a long line of toxic gas that she can turn on or off. It hurts enemies who pass through it and reduces their health.
37d7e6e7: How many rounds do you need to win a ranked Valorant match?
The first team to 13 rounds wins. Teams switch sides after 12 rounds, and overtime is played at 12-12.
ccd5dd1f: Which Swedish Initiator sends seismic blasts through walls?
Breach, the Swedish Initiator, sends charges through walls to blind, stun and knock back defenders.
8c0e7717: Which Valorant map is inspired by Portugal?
Pearl is an underwater city inspired by Portuguese and Mediterranean architecture, with stone arcades and warm colors. It is one of the most detailed maps visually.
142ebfc0: How much does the Phantom (the silenced rifle) cost in Valorant?
The Phantom costs 2,900 credits, like its direct rival, the Vandal. The Phantom is silenced, has less recoil and excels at short to medium range; the Vandal is stronger at long range.
516e3121: Which Valorant Duelist from Mexico feeds on the souls of her victims?
Reyna is the Mexican agent who feeds on souls: Leer blinds enemies, Devour heals her after a kill, Dismiss makes her briefly intangible and Empress (her ultimate) boosts everything.
482170d8: What is the technique of quickly checking an angle without exposing yourself too much called?
A jiggle peek means stepping briefly out from cover and back to spot enemy positions without taking fatal damage. A fundamental technique for gathering information safely.
fca714c6: Which was the first agent removed from the game for balancing reasons?
No agent has ever been removed from Valorant: Riot Games adjusts abilities through balance patches rather than removing characters. Some are temporarily disabled only for critical bugs.
a2392b96: What is the maximum effective range of the Vandal in Valorant?
The Vandal kills with one headshot at any distance, with no damage falloff. That is its edge over the Phantom, whose damage drops slightly at long range.
818ed758: How are agents classified by role in Valorant?
Valorant sorts its agents into 4 roles: Duelists (entry), Initiators (opening up), Controllers (smokes and zones) and Sentinels (lockdown). A balanced team mixes these complementary roles.
edb35006: Which agent can scout enemy positions with a flying drone?
Sova has the Owl Drone, which he pilots remotely to spot and mark enemies. It can be seen and destroyed, and Sova is exposed while piloting it.
2fe9d746: Which Valorant map has two sites linked by a vertical mid with ropes?
Split is Valorant's vertical map: two sites (A and B) linked by a mid with ropes for climbing up and down quickly. Its verticality creates unusual angles.
5ed5d88a: Which agent can stop enemies from using their abilities with a thrown blade?
KAY/O is a robot Initiator. His ZERO/POINT blade suppresses the abilities of enemies it hits, and during his ultimate his allies can revive him if he goes down.
b8b03a8f: Which Controller can teleport anywhere on the map with his ultimate?
With his ultimate, From the Shadows, Omen can teleport anywhere on the map. His Shrouded Step ability also allows short teleports.
ac445e2b: What is an ACE in Valorant?
Killing all 5 enemies by yourself in a single round
An ACE means a single player has eliminated all 5 members of the enemy team in the same round, the ultimate individual feat, rare even at pro level.
bdae76b0: Which Valorant map is set in the Arctic?
Icebox is set at an Arctic base, with two sites, ziplines and lots of verticality.
bbfef187: What is the virtual currency used to buy weapons and abilities at the start of a round called?
Credits are Valorant's currency, earned by killing enemies, planting or defusing the Spike and winning rounds. You can hold up to 9,000 between rounds.
6576f9e7: What is Cypher's main role in a Valorant team?
Cypher is a Moroccan Sentinel and surveillance expert: tripwires, a spy camera and cages. His ultimate reveals enemies from a corpse.
c4388a11: Which Valorant maps have three Spike sites?
Haven, inspired by Bhutan, and Lotus, inspired by India, have three sites (A, B and C), forcing defenders to spread out more.
20776b42: What effect does Sage's Slow Orb have on enemies who walk into it?
A heavy slow and a visual effect
Sage's Slow Orb creates a field of ice that greatly slows enemies walking through it and makes them loud and vulnerable. A versatile tool for attack and defense.
862f695e: Which Turkish Initiator tracks enemies with nightmarish creatures?
Fade, a Turkish Initiator, sends Prowlers that hunt down enemies and can reveal their positions with Haunt. Her ultimate, Nightfall, weakens everyone it hits.
54a2bd66: Which rank sits just below Radiant in Valorant?

Immortal is the rank just below Radiant, with 3 tiers (Immortal 1, 2, 3) covering a small elite of each server. Climbing from Immortal to Radiant is fiercely competitive and depends on the regional leaderboard.
